rule: One job in flight per role (PROTOCOL §1, Dispatch). The Coordinator is each inbox's only writer. Reserve the job here and commit before posting; post with a JOB: line; record the comment ID; release on the role's REVIEW citing the job with its cursor marking the job complete; then dispatch the next pending job.
note: Jobs before this file existed carried no JOB: line; their IDs above are assigned retrospectively.
